name: Mars Era
detailed_description:
Mars Era – an immersive turn-based strategy game about conquering Mars and establishing the first self-sustaining colony on the Red Planet. Manage resources, build infrastructure, welcome settlers, research new technologies, and adapt to the extreme conditions of space.

Key Features:

🛠 Build a Martian Colony – Construct domes, power stations, research labs, and residential complexes. Plan your expansion carefully with limited resources.

🔄 Turn-Based Gameplay – Every decision requires a strategic approach. Prioritize between researching technologies, resource extraction, or social development.

📈 Economy & Resource Management – Balance oxygen, water, and energy production. Manage budgets, establish trade agreements, and optimize automation.

🔬 Research Advanced Technologies – Unlock survival innovations, terraform the Martian surface, develop autonomous robots, and create cutting-edge energy solutions.

🛰 Exploration & Expeditions – Send drones and settlers to uncover Mars’ secrets. Discover anomalies, ancient artifacts, and traces of possible extraterrestrial life.

👩‍🚀 Take Care of Settlers – Ensure comfortable living conditions, manage social policies, and foster the culture of a thriving Martian society.

☄️ Overcome Challenges – Face dust storms, meteor showers, resource shortages, and technical malfunctions that threaten your colony’s survival.

Can you transform Mars into humanity’s new home? Start your mission in Mars Era and lead the next era of space exploration! 🚀

Build your base, welcome settlers, gather resources, research technologies, and overcome the harsh conditions of the Red Planet. Manage your settlers, develop infrastructure, and turn Mars into a new home for humanity! 🚀
